description: This file defines the ImpactDataTransformer class, which extends AbstractTransformer and provides methods to access impact data model attributes, generate URLs for actions, and specify key fields for impact data objects.

classes.name: ImpactDataTransformer
classes.description: A class responsible for transforming impact data objects, providing access to specific model attributes and generating related URLs.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of impact data from the model.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source of impact data from the model.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns an array of URLs for editing, translating, and deleting the impact data, based on the model's ID.
